response.overview: Zhana, a homeless single mother, becomes a surrogate to secure a somewhat stable life for her daughter, Elene. Yet, their impoverished existence remains a constant struggle. Amidst a lack of regulations in the industry, Zhana pushes her body to the absolute limit. Meanwhile, as Elene grows older, she begins to grasp the risks involved, eventually leading to a confrontation with her mother over her choice.
response.title: 9 თვიანი კონტრაქტი
